verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no official, Skills-specific CLI. The command-line surfaces shown (`claude -p`, `claude agents`, `/plugin marketplace add`, `/plugin install`) belong to Claude Code, the host platform Skills runs in, so they earn no credit. The `npx skills add` install in the runtime probe is described as third-party tooling, not an official Anthropic CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
